basis.ref: conditional API endpoint artifacts are required only when in scope

findings.statement: The shape validator reported the conditional API endpoint contract as UNCHECKED. It is out of scope here: the hashed interface inventory says change none and contains no interface items, and the architecture retains the existing internal encoder-to-MPP path without adding an endpoint or message contract.

basis.ref: conditional frontend/UI handoff applies when a user-facing surface exists

findings.statement: The shape validator reported the conditional frontend/UI handoff as UNCHECKED. The design is a backend encoder-path change with no user-facing surface; the architect records the sanctioned no-surface applicability value in ui_evidence.

The canonical shape-check invocation was refused before reading because the authorized skillset-saves link resolves the package to /data/media outside /data/openpilot. The in-project mirror contained the same 10 files byte-for-byte, with matching tree SHA-256 f08ca184492e9c0f7bdf6808bcedfc48597e2968ae9aa3fe87a22ca147b79c00, and its shape check exited 0 with zero failures. This path limitation is preserved; the mirror result is used only for package-content validation.
